ko.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-research verification revision
ko.excerpt: ESH/Eshtronic의 현재 공식 사양과 역사적 routing evidence를 분리하고, EMG 35/40-series active pickup, passive piezo input boundary, B125 per-input buffering, low-Z control placement와 switching transient를 재검증한다. 여기에 McGrath 12-Way Rotary Selector를 3-pickup programmable relay-routing의 현행 사례로 추가해, favorite/previous recall, All-Parallel failsafe와 app-based state remap까지 포함한 programmable state selector를 RavenForge routing taxonomy에 편입한다.

en.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-research verification revision
en.excerpt: Re-audit B06 against manufacturer and technical sources, separating current ESH/Eshtronic specifications from historical routing evidence while verifying active-pickup, passive-piezo, buffering, low-Z control and switching claims. The revision adds the McGrath 12-Way Rotary Selector as a current three-pickup programmable relay-routing case, extending the RavenForge taxonomy to cover recall, failsafe behavior and app-remapped routing states.

de.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-Research-Verifikationsrevision
de.excerpt: B06 trennt aktuelle ESH/Eshtronic-Spezifikationen von historischem Routing und prüft Active-Pickup-, Piezo-, Buffer-, Low-Z- und Switching-Aussagen erneut. Neu hinzu kommt der McGrath 12-Way Rotary Selector als aktuelles Beispiel für programmierbares Drei-Pickup-Relay-Routing; damit erweitert sich die RavenForge-Taxonomie um Recall, Failsafe-Verhalten und per App neu zugeordnete Routing-Zustände.
